description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Spacers and Bushings for the front or Rear Leaf springs.
Made by Suzuki
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 – Small Bushings
Qty 4 – Large Bushings
Qty 2 – Spacers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki Sj410 1980 – 1984 All Models
